verdict: A very close, clean rebuild of the Wikipedia Community feed whose main gaps are the article image's slightly different scale and crop and over-tracked body text that moves the extract's truncation, built as well-named flex HTML with a data-driven bottom nav.

top_defects.what: extra letter-spacing (tracking 0.1–0.12px on Roboto 14) widens every line, so the 4th line truncates at 'Cheltenham…' instead of 'Cheltenham Tr…'; lines visibly longer than the reference's
badge image scaled and cropped slightly differently (crown and arms offset ~5–10 px, arms wider at card edges); the grid's image cells reach meanDiff 32–35

top_defects.where: tabs row, date, section description, banner
top_defects.what: text blocks sit ~2–3 px (about 1 dp) higher than in the reference; tab labels and 'Today - Nov 12, 2026' shifted up

top_defects.where: red 'new' dots on Saved and Activity
top_defects.what: #d73333 instead of #b32424, and placed ~3 px higher and further right
outline drawn in #202122 at full strength, darker and heavier than the reference's grey stroke; 'EN' box and letters slightly larger
Material Symbols Wi-Fi and battery glyphs differ slightly in shape and size from the system ones

strengths: Every block and text of the reference present with the right palette (#3366cc tab and Home, #eaecf0 banner, #e8f0ff pill, #54595d secondary text), Noto Serif title and Roboto elsewhere
Real assets used correctly: wordmark, globe, app icons for save/share/nav, and the article photo under a veil
Bottom navigation built once as a template with 5 data items; layers named for nearly every element (42/48)
